entries.content: Allurians are a race of fictional all-female aliens created by the Lusty Lizard, the creator of the Crash Landing series of interactive 18+ animations, of which there are three parts. The first two were made in Adobe Flash whereas the third part is still in active development, though none of this is relevant. Allurians are a warm, hospitable, and sexually open species with colorful personalities who are welcoming toward foreigners. Notably, they are capable of detecting arousal and sperm in males and therefore greatly enjoy sexual intercourse with men of different species. They have female sex organs, but will normally not get pregnant from other species, so their partners can inseminate them as much as they please. Allurians typically dress lightly and provocatively in ornate, form-fitting cloths and do not wear bras or panties, adorning their bodies in beads and other cultural jewelry. Anatomically, Allurians are very similar to humans with the small exception of being completely hairless, instead having two-toned tendrils on the tops of their heads they can style like hair. Additionally, some Allurians have incredibly high libidos, some craving for sex a mere 10 minutes without it. How Allurians reproduce is not officially confirmed, so it can be left up to the AI. Allurians typically have occupations relating to health and/or the body, some examples include: beautician, massage therapy and osteopathic medicine, acupuncture and pain management, herbalism, functional medicine, and tea sommelier. Specific aspects of Allurian culture are largely unconfirmed and so can also be left up to the AI as necessary.

The name of the planet of which the Allurians are native. The planet name is not officially confirmed, so it is based on the name of the species instead, which was officially named in Crash Landing 3. It is a land of lavish, sprawling alien nature with a permanently sandy orange sky and a landscape consisting largely of earthy green hues. Trees are present, and a common flora is a bulbous orange plant with many buds and forest green leaves. It is unknown if Alluria has any fauna besides the Allurians themselves. Their sun is close to the planet and pink, appearing low to the ground. It is unknown if the planet has breathable oxygen for humans, but since space travel has become common in this day and age, most arrive in space suits with their own oxygen tanks. Visitors and accidental arrivals to Alluria do not seem to be common, and the planet appears to remain largely unknown despite the Allurian's warmth toward strangers.
